const overview=document.getElementById('campbox-video'),cover=document.getElementById('video-start'),watch=document.getElementById('play-overview');function startOverview(){overview.currentTime=0;overview.muted=false;overview.play().catch(()=>{cover.hidden=false});overview.scrollIntoView({behavior:window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth',block:'center'})}watch.addEventListener('click',startOverview);cover.addEventListener('click',startOverview);overview.addEventListener('playing',()=>{cover.hidden=true;watch.textContent='↻ Смотреть с начала · 26 секунд'});overview.addEventListener('pause',()=>{cover.hidden=false});overview.play().catch(()=>{cover.hidden=false});
</script><a aria-label="Прокрутить страницу наверх" class="back-top" hidden="" href="#page-top" id="back-top"><span aria-hidden="true">↑</span> Наверх</a><script>const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tabs [role=tab]')];function select(i){tabs.forEach((t,j)=>{t.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(i===j));t.tabIndex=i===j?0:-1;document.getElementById('panel-'+j).hidden=i!==j})}tabs.forEach((t,i)=>{t.addEventListener('click',()=>select(i));t.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{let n;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')n=(i+1)%3;else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')n=(i+2)%3;else if(e.key==='Home')n=0;else if(e.key==='End')n=2;else return;e.preventDefault();select(n);tabs[n].focus()})});
</script><script>
(function(){
  const n=id=>document.getElementById(id), fmt=v=>new Intl.NumberFormat('ru-RU',{maximumFractionDigits:1}).format(v);
  function calc(){
    const q=Math.max(0, Number(n('roi-bookings')?.value)||0),
          m=Math.max(0, Number(n('roi-minutes')?.value)||0),
          w=Math.max(0, Number(n('roi-hourly')?.value)||0);
    const h=q*m/60;
    if(n('roi-hours')) n('roi-hours').textContent = fmt(h)+' часов';
    if(n('roi-cost')) n('roi-cost').textContent = w>0 ? fmt(h*w)+' ₽' : 'Не указана';
  }
  ['roi-bookings','roi-minutes','roi-hourly'].forEach(id=>n(id)?.addEventListener('input',calc));
  calc();
  const cb=[...document.querySelectorAll('.custom-choices input')];
  function update(){ const chosen=cb.filter(c=>c.checked).map(c=>c.value); const summary=n('custom-summary'); if(summary) summary.textContent=chosen.length ? 'Можно разобрать на встрече: '+chosen.join(', ')+'.' : 'Выберите темы, которые хотите обсудить в первую очередь.'; }
  cb.forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('change',update));
  update();
})();
</script>

<script>(function(){const top=document.getElementById('back-top');if(!top)return;function refresh(){top.hidden=(window.scrollY||window.pageYOffset)<900;}window.addEventListener('scroll',refresh,{passive:true});refresh();})();</script><script id="campbox-t123-bridge">(function () {
  if (window.parent === window) return;
  let sentHeight = 0;
  function reportHeight() {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const body = document.body;
    if (!root || !body) return;
    const height = Math.ceil(Math.max(
      root.scrollHeight, body.scrollHeight,
      root.offsetHeight, body.offsetHeight
    ));
    if (height > 300 && Math.abs(height - sentHeight) > 2) {
      sentHeight = height;
      window.parent.postMessage({type:'campbox-kp:height',height:height,version:'v18-rc'}, '*');
    }
  }
  if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(reportHeight);
    ro.observe(document.documentElement);
    ro.observe(document.body);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', reportHeight);
  window.addEventListener('resize', reportHeight);
  window.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
    if (event.data && event.data.type === 'campbox-kp:measure') reportHeight();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => requestAnimationFrame(reportHeight));
  setTimeout(reportHeight, 400);
  setTimeout(reportHeight, 1500);
  setTimeout(reportHeight, 4000);
})();</script></body></html>
